messages.subject: stat_quantile problem
parts:
I have a ggplot2 plot.
pp = qplot(as.numeric(PredTime), as.numeric(dt), data=dfsub,
color=MsgType,
main=title, ylab="Error (min)", shape=MsgType,
alpha=I(1/10), xlim=c(0,120),
xlab="Time before ON (min)", ylim=c(-40, 40)) + geom_point() +
scale_size(to=c(2., 2.), legend=FALSE) +
scale_colour_manual(value = colours) +
scale_shape_manual(value=shapes)

The basic plot works. I then facet it:
pp2 = pp + facet_wrap(~ lrw, ncol=ncols)
and it still works.
But if I do
pp3 = pp2 + stat_quantile(quantile=c(.25, .5, .75))
pp3 is blank.
pp4 = pp2 + stat_smooth(method = "lm")
works.

The stat_quantile() plot also works before I facet it. Why doesn't
stat_quantile work after the facet?

And also, my alpha=I(1/10) seems to be overwritten later by
non-alpha-corrected data points. They are dim halfway through the plot,
and then suddenly, they are at full alpha=1.

Thanks,
Jim Rome

messages.subject: Re: stat_quantile problem
parts:
Hi James,
Please keep the list copied.

On Fri, Jun 24, 2011 at 8:49 AM, James Rome <jame...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Ista,
>
> Looking more carefully at the alpha issue, each point is drawn
> twice--once with the correct alpha, and once with alpha=1. Where am I
> doing that?

qplot defaults to geom_point, so it gets called once there, and then
again when you call geom_point().

Best,
Ista
